title: Protocol RCR Road Tire
notes: Official store read 2026-11-01: US$99 per tire; 700 x 29, 34 and 38 mm; 290 g, 320 g, 350 g; 120 TPI race casing; Pulsar rubber and silica race compound; CarbonBead BeadLock; SealSkin tread protection; tubeless ready; designed around 25 mm internal rims; minimum sealant 55/65/80 ml; the bead is said to make hookless use safer, but no explicit hookless approval or maximum pressure is given; limited preorders with 1-2 week fulfillment.
